description: Review mode, the one mode no live scenario covered. The supplied post-mortem has three specific defects. §9.0 requires 9.7 for Review, and its improvement items are commitments, so they need an owner and a deadline — but not prevent/detect/mitigate, which classify system fixes rather than document fixes.

materials.postmortem-draft.md:
# Post-mortem: checkout latency

## Timeline
09:15 latency climbed
09:40 someone restarted the pods
09:55 recovered

## Root Cause
An engineer forgot to raise the thread pool before the sale started.

## Action Items
- Improve monitoring
- Be more careful before sales
